13. Sale by description Where there is a contract for the sale of goods by description, there is an implied condition that the goods shall correspond with the description; and if the sale be by sample, as well as by description, it is not sufficient that the bulk of the goods As at 11 Sep 2010 Version 05-d0-06 page 7 Published on www.legislation.wa.gov.au corresponds with the sample if the goods do not also correspond with the description.
